name: Sandman
description: Inhabits neural interfaces and induces micro-sleep episodes — 1-3 seconds of unconsciousness that the user experiences as a blink.
observed_behavior: Triggers sleep-onset neural patterns during waking hours. The episodes are brief enough to be mistaken for fatigue but occur even when the user is alert.
story_hooks: A driver micro-sleeps at a critical moment and wakes to find the vehicle has navigated itself around an obstacle — did the car's AI take over, or did Sandman hand control to something else?
